title: Starter pack
description: A curated, ordered onboarding pack of existing use cases for one data source and one goal (security or operations). Packs reference UCs by id only; the UC sidecar stays the source of truth for SPL and guidance. Gated by audit-starter-packs and published under /api/v1/starter-packs/.

$schema.description: Repo-relative path to this schema file (for editor validation).

id.description: Stable kebab-case pack id. Must match the file name (data/starter-packs/<id>.json). Permanent once published.

description.description: Plain-language summary shown on the pack card. Who it is for and what it catches.

goal.description: The wizard and plan_rollout only surface packs whose goal matches the user's selected goal.

status.description: Drafts are hidden from the UI and MCP by default. Publishing fails while audit-starter-packs reports warnings for the pack.

pairId.description: Sibling pack with the opposite goal for the same data source, or null when industry practice has no distinct list for the other goal. A UC may not appear in both packs of a pair.

equipment.description: Inventory slugs (EQUIPMENT ids such as 'windows' or compound model ids such as 'cisco_catalyst_center'). The wizard prefers packs whose equipment matches the user's inventory.

industrySources.description: The external lists the steps were picked from. Keeps future edits anchored to industry practice rather than catalogue criticality.

steps.description: Ordered UC references. No SPL override; the UC sidecar is the source of truth.

nextPacks.description: Suggested follow-on packs. Suggestions only: the UI shows them when the user's inventory matches the next pack's equipment.

curationNotes.description: Reviewer notes on known content gaps in packed UCs (for example a threshold that differs from the vendor default). Shown to curators, not to end users.

splunkbaseApps.description: Primary Splunkbase add-ons the pack needs. Empty for packs that run on Splunk's own _internal / _audit data.

sourcetypes.description: Sourcetypes the pack steps search. Used by the audit (step coverage) and by the paste-sourcetypes matcher (pack unlock).

indexes.description: Splunk internal indexes the steps read (e.g. _internal, _audit). Customer index names are deployment choices and are not listed.

notes.description: Licences, roles, or input settings that are not Splunk apps (for example DNA Advantage, SUPER-ADMIN-ROLE, 'enable Collect BGP data').

control.description: Which control, alert rule, or recommendation in the source the pack follows.
